notes: The tangent holonomy phase is built from Jacobian-derived projective tangent frames rather than from the weaker single-mode Jacobian modal phase.
The sign harmonization factor fixes the global orientation convention so positive counter-clockwise state curvature matches positive Jacobian/tangent curvature.
The accepted Phase 7 holonomy observable is the harmonized tangent holonomy phase, not the old Jacobian modal phase.
Harmonized tangent phase is expected to agree in sign with state signed flux on trusted R1 loops.
The mixed-state lane uses a dephased density matrix rho_eta = (1-eta)|psi><psi| + eta diag(p) + eps I/n and a discrete Uhlmann-like transport phase.
The current dephased-response surrogate damps the phase-current gain by (1-eta); it is an implementation scaffold, not yet a full CPTP dynamics model.
